LOOK: As early as 6 a.m. on Wednesday, some members of the transport group Manibela gather at the Philcoa in Quezon City for the start of their three-day transport strike against corruption in government.

Manibela chair Mar Balbuena says around 100,000 members are expected to participate in the strike across the country. | @MJSalcedoINQ
